text: Shipwrecked sailor Edward Parker is put ashore on a South Seas island ruled by Dr. Moreau, whose screaming laboratory is known as the House of Pain. Moreau has been [surgically shaping animals into people|wrong|meddling with life itself], and the [beast-men who chant his Law in the jungle|who_suffers|monsters who suffer] scatter at the crack of his whip. He introduces Parker to Lota, a gentle young woman whose [fingernails are turning back into claws|images|wounded and changing bodies], then [destroys the only boat|trigger|cut off and trapped] so he can watch what happens between them.
